correctness.rationale: Verified fixed d>=s>=1, normalized strictly positive affine weights and every real beta. Orthogonality of distinct homogeneous t-powers gives exact weights; polynomial divisibility by 1-t identifies the admissible errors; weighted Cauchy–Schwarz gives and attains the exact minimum. The torus Parseval integrand has one maximizing phase configuration, with positive-definite covariance Hessian and determinant product p_j. Laplace localization yields the factor (4pi)^(-(s-1)/2) product p_j^(-1/2), and positive-series comparison establishes the full trichotomy. s=1 follows directly. The included standalone script was executed from its actual path and passed rational finite cases and Gaussian scaling checks; the analytic proof, not finite testing, supports the infinite quantifiers.

value.rationale: Recent radial Dirichlet cyclicity work singles out the 3/2 barrier for elementary methods, whereas the known unrestricted cyclicity threshold for the boundary-zero affine polynomial is 2. The new exact minimizer reveals that the intermediate gap is intrinsic to the natural one-generator approximation restriction, not a defect of a particular trial sequence; the support-rank threshold (s+1)/2 and sharp errors apply to every fixed positive weight vector in arbitrary dimension. This is a motivated structural obstruction, not a routine reformulation of unrestricted cyclicity, nor a claim to settle it anew.
